summary: v52d escrow account-first flow — frontend-only validation. Register gate, verify page (ok + err), unverified-login gating, pre-seeded signed-in flow, header (bell left of avatar), avatar menu (profile → password → signout in order), profile update, change-password 401 toast, notifications empty + badge '1' + mark-all-read, sign-out → /escrow/login. All critical UI testids present and functional. 1 real bug + 1 UX issue found.

ui_bugs.issue: Unverified-account login shows generic 'Invalid email or password' instead of the backend's actual message 'Please verify your email before signing in'. Root cause: the login handler catches the 403 (unverified) from /api/v1/escrow-accounts/auth/login and falls through to /api/v1/escrow-signatories/auth/login (fallthrough codes include 403), which then returns a 401 'Invalid email or password'. The user-facing error from the account endpoint is swallowed.

The sonner toast container (ol[data-sonner-toaster]) sits above the header on the signed-in page and intercepts pointer events at the avatar button area. elementFromPoint at the avatar's center returns the toast <li>, so a real user clicking the avatar while a toast is still visible (e.g. the 'Signed in' toast right after login) will have the click swallowed. Playwright's force-click also failed with 30s timeout; only JS .click() worked.

action_items: FIX unverified login error: In EscrowSignatoryLogin.jsx submitLogin, detect the account-endpoint's structured 403 detail ({error:'unverified', message:'...'}) and surface that message (via showApiError on accErr or a direct toast.error) INSTEAD of falling through to signatory login. Suggest: only fall through on 401/404; on 403 with detail.error==='unverified', call showApiError(accErr) and return.

FIX toast overlay z-index/pointer-events: constrain ol[data-sonner-toaster] to the toast-sized box (pointer-events:none on the container, pointer-events:auto only on individual toasts) so it doesn't intercept clicks on the header avatar / bell.
critical_code_review_comments: EscrowAccountRegister uses useMemo(() => fetch, []) to load countries — this works but useEffect is the idiomatic choice for side effects; useMemo semantics don't guarantee a single invocation under React StrictMode double-render.
EscrowSignatoryLogin fallthrough list includes 403 — this masks the account endpoint's semantic 'unverified' error. See action_items.

showApiError likely doesn't recognise detail payloads that are objects ({error,message}) — the toast shows 'HTTP 401' + generic message. Consider branching when typeof detail==='object' to prefer detail.message.
Toast library z-index/pointer-events needs scoping to avoid blocking page interactions on the signed-in dashboard.

rca of the issue.unverified_login_wrong_toast: EscrowSignatoryLogin.submitLogin tries POST /api/v1/escrow-accounts/auth/login first. For an unverified account, the backend correctly returns 403 with detail={error:'unverified', message:'Please verify your email ...'}. The frontend catches 401/403/404 and silently falls through to /api/v1/escrow-signatories/auth/login, which returns 401 'Invalid email or password' because that email isn't a signatory. The user then sees the signatory 401, hiding the real unverified-reason. Fix: don't fall through on 403 (or specifically not when detail.error==='unverified'); call showApiError(accErr) in that case.
rca of the issue.avatar_click_intercepted_by_toast: Right after login a sonner success toast renders. The toast container ol[data-sonner-toaster] is a fixed-position wide element overlapping the top-right header. Because pointer-events isn't set to 'none' on the empty regions of the container, elementFromPoint at the avatar's coordinates returns the toast <li>, so a real/Playwright click lands on the toast, not on the button. Playwright click (even with force) times out because the toast element blocks the actionability check; only js-dispatched button.click() worked. Fix at the Toaster config / global CSS.
